crossRefs.note: Samuel told all Yahweh’s words to the people who asked him for a king.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel told all Yahweh’s words to the people who asked him for a king.
translations.bsb: So Samuel spoke all the words of the LORD to the people who were asking him for a king.
translations.kjv: And Samuel told all the words of the LORD unto the people that asked of him a king.
translations.asv: And Samuel told all the words of Jehovah unto the people that asked of him a king.
